item.name: Charge
item.effect: Builds 1 Energy so you can spend it on later moves.
item.cardSummary: Free resource move that banks 1 Energy for higher-cost abilities on later turns.

item.name: Heal
item.cardSummary: 2-Energy heal that tops up your Brainrot during longer fights.

item.name: Shield
item.effect: Blocks all incoming damage for one round.
item.cardSummary: 2-Energy full-round block that nullifies the next wave of damage.

item.name: Feathers
item.effect: Sends a feather tornado along a path that damages enemies it hits.
item.cardSummary: 2-Energy path attack that hurls a feather tornado into enemies.

item.name: Shoot
item.effect: Fires a gun shot at the enemy Brainrot.
item.cardSummary: 2-Energy gun shot for light single-target damage.

item.name: Splash
item.effect: Throws a splash that deals light area damage.
item.cardSummary: 2-Energy splash for light area damage around the target.

item.name: Bite
item.effect: Summons giant teeth that bite the enemy Brainrot.
item.cardSummary: 3-Energy bite that clamps giant teeth on the enemy for solid damage.

item.name: Fry
item.effect: Smacks the enemy Brainrot with a frying pan.
item.cardSummary: 3-Energy frying-pan smack for medium single-target damage.

item.name: Mr Beast
item.effect: Summons Mr Beast, who attacks with showers of cash.
item.cardSummary: 3-Energy cash-shower summon that hits the enemy for medium damage.

item.name: Sword
item.effect: Swings a sword for solid melee damage.
item.cardSummary: 3-Energy sword swing for solid melee pressure.

item.name: Wheel Attack
item.effect: Throws a spinning tire that hits hard on impact.
item.cardSummary: 3-Energy spinning-tire throw with heavy impact damage for its cost.

item.name: Zap
item.effect: Calls down a lightning strike on the target.
item.cardSummary: 3-Energy lightning strike for medium single-target damage.

item.name: Bomb
item.effect: Throws a bomb that explodes for massive damage.
item.cardSummary: 4-Energy bomb burst for massive single-hit damage.

item.name: Fire Blast
item.effect: Unleashes a stream of fire that burns the enemy Brainrot.
item.cardSummary: 4-Energy fire stream that burns the enemy for heavy damage.

item.name: Firework
item.effect: Launches a firework rocket that explodes after hitting the enemy.
item.cardSummary: 4-Energy firework rocket that explodes for heavy damage on impact.

item.name: Grow a Garden
item.effect: Grows flowers that drain the enemy’s health and restore it to your Brainrot.
item.cardSummary: 5-Energy hybrid that drains enemy HP and heals your Brainrot at the same time.

item.name: Whirlpool
item.effect: Summons a water tornado that deals massive damage and launches the enemy into the air.
item.cardSummary: 6-Energy water tornado that deals massive damage and launches the enemy.
